jobs.title: Strategic Finance Partner
jobs.description:
Job Summary:
We are hiring for a Finance Business Partner to serve as a strategic partner with our Fuels Marketing business unit leader. This role will be the primary finance liaison for the SVP, Fuels Marketing to understand strategic goals, challenge assumptions, drive accountability, and provide financial guidance. The Finance Business Partner will also collaborate with accounting, FP&A, and operational teams to ensure alignment on financial reporting and strategy, translating of complex data for non-financial stakeholders. This position stays abreast of economic/financial trends to develop business strategies and tactics. This position is based in Newton, MA and requires a minimum of 4 days a week in the office.
At Global Partners, business starts with people. Since 1933, we’ve believed in taking care of our customers, our guests, our communities, and each other—and that belief continues to guide us.

The Global Spirit is how we work to fuel that long term commitment to success. As a Fortune 500 company with 90+ years of experience, we’re proud to fuel communities—responsibly and sustainably. We show up every day with grit, passion, and purpose—anticipating needs, building lasting relationships, and creating shared value.

Job Description:
- Financial Reporting: Preparing regular reports on key performance indicators (KPIs), financial results, cost drivers, and profitability metrics.​ Analyze and interpret financial results, providing actional insights and recommendation. Identify strengths, gaps and recommendation adjustments to close gaps.
- Budgeting and Forecasting: Lead budget development and managment, forecasting/re-forecasting, and variance analysis process for the Fuels Marketing Business Unit.
- Capital Expenditure Management: Supporting decisions related to capital investments and asset management. Active participant creating a Retail process and system of modeling and supporting all capital planning and deployment​.
- Financial Modeling: Building and maintaining financial models and modeling tools to support investment decisions, pricing strategies, and resource planning. Support business cases and ROI analysis for new initiatives and projects, analyzing of sales opportunities, inventory/expenses, and profitability. Understanding the levers the BU can move to drive or capture revenue​.
- Analysis and Recommendation: Identifying trends, opportunities, and challenges in the Fuels Marketing business unit providing recommendations for improvements always looking for opportunities focused on leverage opportunities with growth​.
- Cost Management: Analyzing and optimizing operating expenses to improve and optimize profitability.​
- Strategic Planning: Work closely with the SVP, Fuels Marketing and other stakeholders, including FP&A and Accounting, in the strategic planning process and financial decision-making to ensure that financial considerations are integrated into business planning and operations. Facilitate communication between Finance departments and other parts of the organization

Additional Job Description:
- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field (MBA, CPA, or CMA a plus).​
- 7+ years of experience in FP&A, strategic finance, or a related finance or accounting role, including 3+ years of team leadership.​
- Proven ability to influence and challenge stakeholders constructively; comfortable working in a fast-paced, cross-functional, and dynamic business environment.​
- Advanced Excel, financial modeling, and data analysis skills; proficiency in financial planning tools and/or BI tools​
- Excellent analytical, communication, interpersonal, and executive presentation skills; ability to synthesize financials for non-financial stakeholders.​
- Track record of partnering with senior business leaders and influencing strategic decisions.
- Business acumen with a strong understanding of financial statements and performance metrics.​
- Ability to lead, mentor and coach a team of professionals.

Pay Range:

$136,200.00 - $204,200.00
The pay range for this position is outlined above. The final amount offered at the start of employment is determined based on factors including, but not limited to, experience level, knowledge, skills, abilities and geographic location, and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance and market factors.

Our Commitments to You
- Coins! We offer competitive salaries and opportunities for growth. We have an amazing Talent Development Team who create trainings for growth and job development.

- Health & Wellness - Medical, Dental, Visions and Life Insurance. Along with additional wellness support.

- The Road Ahead – We offer 401k and a match component!

- Professional Development - We provide tuition reimbursement; this benefit is offered after 6 months of service.

What to Expect From the Hiring Process
We value passion and potential. Please apply if you’re qualified and interested—we’d love to hear from you.

A member of our Talent Acquisition team will review your application and may connect you with the hiring manager if your experience is a strong match.

Interviews are conducted virtually and in person, depending on the role. We’ll provide more details about next steps if selected to move forward.

Global Partners LP is an equal opportunity employer. We foster a company culture where ideas from all people help us grow, move and thrive. We embrace the diversity of all applicants and do not discriminate against race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status or any other basis prohibited by federal, state or local law. If you have a disability and need an accommodation to apply, please contact our recruiting department at 781-747-9675 or 781-7GP-WORK.

jobs.title: Transformation Office Program Manager
jobs.description:
Job Summary:
Global Partners is seeking a highly capable, adaptable and versatile Enterprise Program Manager to support our Transformation Office and ensure enterprise initiatives are executed with discipline, consistency, and visibility. This role partners closely with executive leaders and workstream owners to coordinate governance activities, prepare executive forums, facilitate meetings, track decisions and action items, and ensure transformation initiatives remain organized, aligned, and moving forward. Success in this role comes from exceptional organization, follow-through, executive communication, and the ability to manage many moving pieces simultaneously. This role is expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, influencing decisions and driving progress and outcomes in a dynamic and evolving environment. Given deep involvement in senior leadership forums and regular exposure to candid, highly sensitive, and confidential discussions, this role demands exceptional discretion, maturity, and judgment. The successful candidate must be senior and experienced enough to navigate nuance, safeguard the candor of executive dialogue, and earn and sustain the trust of the executive team to be effective.
At Global Partners, business starts with people. Since 1933, we’ve believed in taking care of our customers, our guests, our communities, and each other—and that belief continues to guide us.

The Global Spirit is how we work to fuel that long term commitment to success. As a Fortune 500 company with 90+ years of experience, we’re proud to fuel communities—responsibly and sustainably. We show up every day with grit, passion, and purpose—anticipating needs, building lasting relationships, and creating shared value.

Job Description:
- Serve as the primary point of accountability for the integration, coordination and execution health of enterprise transformation initiatives, ensuring alignment across multiple workstreams, programs, and business functions.
- Develop and maintain an integrated view of transformation efforts, including scope, timelines, overarching plan, milestones, risks, dependencies, and value realization.
- Support the implementation, continuous improvement, and long-term evolution of enterprise governance processes, frameworks, and operating models. As the Transformation Office matures, this role will have opportunities to contribute to the design and enhancement of governance practices and execution frameworks.  Support transformation leaders by coordinating execution plans, maintaining integrated project information, and ensuring deliverables remain visible and on track. Serve as a central point of coordination and visibility, enabling leadership to understand progress, risks, interdependencies, and required decisions.
- Facilitate cross-functional alignment by proactively identifying and managing dependencies, risks, and conflicts across initiatives.
- Lead and facilitate transformation program meetings, working sessions, and strategic planning discussions, ensuring effective structure, documentation, and follow-through on actions.
- Directly manage key transformation or stand-alone process improvement programs or projects as required utilizing corporate best practices and ensuring effective delivery. (i.e. OST Current State Process Documentation, SLA Discovery).
- Partner with business and enterprise functional leaders to define and document initiative scope, processes, SOPs, and operational plans, ensuring sustainability beyond initial implementation.
- Operationalize and run enterprise governance structures, including leadership updates, steering committees, and decision forums; ensure these forums drive decisions, accountability, and forward momentum rather than status updates.
- Handle highly confidential and sensitive information with the utmost discretion, exercising sound judgment about what is documented, shared, escalated, or held in confidence and always protect the openness and candor of executive and governance discussions.
- Prepare and deliver executive-level reporting and insights, including dashboards, status updates, risk summaries, and decision materials.
- Identify risks and issues, and drive issue resolution and escalation management, ensuring timely and effective mitigation of risks impacting transformation outcomes.
- Collaborate with change management and communications partners to support adoption, alignment, and readiness across impacted teams.
- Act as a connector across strategy and execution, ensuring that enterprise priorities are effectively operationalized and delivered.
- Partner with finance and business leaders to track investment, value realization, and benefits across the transformation portfolio; when applicable, surface trade-offs, funding implications, and risk-adjusted outcomes to support executive decision-making.
-  Partner with program managers, project managers, and workstream leads across complex initiatives; set expectations for how work is planned, tracked, and delivered, and  support governance activities.
- Operate under strategic oversight with a high degree of autonomy, owning outcomes across multiple initiatives .

Additional Job Description:
- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations, or a related field required.
- 8 to 12 years supporting enterprise programs, transformation offices, PMOs, or strategic initiatives in a highly matrixed environment.
- Proven experience supporting complex, cross-functional transformation initiatives in a fast-paced matrixed organization.
- Strong program and project management skills with expertise in scope, schedule, risk, issue, dependency, and action tracking.
- Experience with process improvement, operating models, governance practices, and bringing structure to complex initiatives.
- Strong facilitator and relationship builder with the ability to influence stakeholders, coordinate cross-functional teams, and support executive decision-making. Excellent communication skills with the ability to quickly synthesize complex information into clear executive ready materials, dashboards, and presentations.
- Strong business acumen, critical thinking, and sound judgment with the ability to navigate ambiguity and prioritize competing demands.
- Exceptional attention to detail with a proven ability to manage multiple priorities, follow through on commitments, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks.
- High level of professionalism, discretion, and executive maturity with experience supporting confidential leadership discussions.
- Self-motivated   adaptable, and comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy in a dynamic environment.
- Tools — proficiency in program and project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Smartsheet, JIRA, Asana, or similar).
- PMP certification required (or equivalent program management certification).
- Change management certification (Prosci or equivalent) preferred with a strong understanding of change management principles and adoption strategies.

Pay Range:

$160,500.00 - $240,800.00
The pay range for this position is outlined above. The final amount offered at the start of employment is determined based on factors including, but not limited to, experience level, knowledge, skills, abilities and geographic location, and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance and market factors.

jobs.title: General Manager - Wheels
jobs.description:
Job Summary:
As the General Manager, you are the heartbeat of your store — responsible for leading operations, inspiring your team, and ensuring that every Guest experience reflects the Global brand promise. You’ll oversee all aspects of business performance, including sales growth, profitability, staffing, training, compliance, and community engagement.This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who thrives on connection — with Guests, team members, and the local community. You’ll cultivate an environment where hospitality and operational excellence go hand-in-hand, ensuring that your store operates efficiently, safely, and successfully every single day.
At Global Partners, business starts with people. Since 1933, we’ve believed in taking care of our customers, our guests, our communities, and each other—and that belief continues to guide us.

The Global Spirit is how we work to fuel that long term commitment to success. As a Fortune 500 company with 90+ years of experience, we’re proud to fuel communities—responsibly and sustainably. We show up every day with grit, passion, and purpose—anticipating needs, building lasting relationships, and creating shared value.

Job Description:
- Leadership & Culture
- Lead by example to uphold Global mission and Four Pillars.
- Inspire, develop, and empower your management and associate teams to deliver exceptional Guest service and operational performance.
- Build a culture rooted in collaboration, accountability, and hospitality.
- Recruit, train, and retain high-performing team members who embody the brand’s values.
- Provide clear communication, direction, and feedback through regular coaching and team meetings.
- Foster a safe, positive, and inclusive workplace where every team member feels valued.
- Guest Experience & Community Engagement
- Ensure every Guest receives an outstanding experience characterized by warmth, attentiveness, and genuine connection.
- Lead your team to consistently deliver best-in-class service and maintain impeccable store presentation.
- Resolve Guest concerns promptly, using feedback as an opportunity for growth and improvement.
- Represent Global within the community — building relationships, supporting local initiatives, and promoting the brand’s commitment to Local and Community.
- Operational & Financial Management
- Oversee all store operations, ensuring adherence to company policies, brand standards, and safety requirements.
- Drive financial performance by managing labor, inventory, and operating costs effectively.
- Analyze sales reports, expense summaries, and performance metrics to identify opportunities for improvement.
- Develop and execute action plans to achieve revenue, margin, and profitability goals.
- Ensure compliance with all company systems, procedures, and audit standards.
- Maintain operational excellence through proactive planning and problem-solving.
- Food Service & Merchandising
- Oversee all aspects of food service — including preparation, presentation, and freshness of menu and grab-and-go offerings.
- Ensure strict adherence to food safety, sanitation, and allergen control procedures.
- Collaborate with culinary and merchandising teams to drive innovation, optimize product mix, and maintain visual appeal.
- Monitor quality and freshness of all products to meet or exceed Guest expectations.
- Maintain food safety standards, and have or obtain ServSafe training and certification at the time of or within 90 days of site assignment
- Safety, Compliance & Facility Management
- Ensure a safe and secure environment for Guests, associates, and vendors at all times.
- Enforce compliance with health, sanitation, OSHA, and environmental guidelines.
- Conduct regular safety and maintenance inspections and coordinate timely repairs.
- Lead safety training, emergency preparedness, and compliance initiatives across the store.

Additional Job Description:
- This position requires ServSafe, or other approved Food Safety Certification, within 90 days of employment or promotion.
- Minimum 5 years of progressive retail, restaurant, or hospitality management experience; multi-department or full-store leadership preferred.
- Demonstrated success in team leadership, operations management, and financial performance.
- Strong business acumen with the ability to interpret data and make strategic decisions.
- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
- Proven ability to foster teamwork, motivate others, and resolve conflict effectively.
- Strong understanding of food safety, merchandising, and guest service standards.
- Tech-savvy and proficient with POS systems, reporting tools, and standard office software.
- Flexible availability, including nights, weekends, and holidays as needed.
- PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS
- Ability to lift up to 50 pounds using proper lifting techniques.
- Frequent standing, walking, bending, and reaching throughout shift.
- Ability to traverse all areas of the store.
- Occasional desk/computer tasks may be required.
- Prolonged periods of standing and occasional lifting of products such as beverages, milk crates, and packaged goods.
- Frequent exposure to cold, heat, wet surfaces, and food allergens.
- Standing, bending, and lifting throughout shift.
- Use of food service equipment and point-of-sale systems.
- Fast-paced retail environment requires attention to detail and accuracy.
- High School Diploma High School Diploma or Equivalent

Pay Range:

$45,000.00 - $81,972.00

The final amount offered at the start of employment is determined based on factors including, but not limited to, experience level, knowledge, skills, abilities and geographic location, and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance and market factors.

jobs.title: Senior Enterprise IT Program Manager
jobs.description:
Job Summary:
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Senior Enterprise IT Program Manager to drive and lead highly complex, enterprise-wide business and technology initiatives. This role is the central point of integration and program leadership across the full ecosystem of each program, ensuring all workstreams operate as a single, aligned initiative where progress translates into real business outcomes.

This is not another project management role. It is an individual contributor role that combines direct hands-on project leadership with executive engagement. You will be responsible for each program's structure, discipline, and operating rhythm required to deliver at scale. The role brings clarity to complexity, anticipates risks before they surface, and serves as the critical bridge between a program's technical delivery teams and business leadership—translating highly technical concepts, trade-offs, and dependencies into clear business implications while ensuring that critical business needs are accurately understood and reflected in technical execution. The result: Executives and Senior Business and Enterprise leaders have the insight needed to make timely, informed program decisions, and every program is planned and delivered to maximize business value through sound technical implementation.

The successful candidate is an expert program manager with significant experience leading large, cross-functional, enterprise-wide initiatives. This is a role for an emotionally intelligent leader with outstanding judgment and sharp business acumen—someone who engages credibly with Executive and Senior Business leaders, navigates technical detail and business priorities with equal fluency, and runs a disciplined program operating model that drives alignment, accountability, and execution.

This is a full time onsite office-based position located in Newton, MA.
At Global Partners, business starts with people. Since 1933, we’ve believed in taking care of our customers, our guests, our communities, and each other—and that belief continues to guide us.

The Global Spirit is how we work to fuel that long term commitment to success. As a Fortune 500 company with 90+ years of experience, we’re proud to fuel communities—responsibly and sustainably. We show up every day with grit, passion, and purpose—anticipating needs, building lasting relationships, and creating shared value.

Job Description:
Program Ownership & Delivery
- Own end-to-end delivery of large, complex programs, aligned to business objectives and enterprise priorities

- Serve as the primary point of accountability for program outcomes, execution health, and risk management

- Translate strategic objectives into clear, executable plans across multiple workstreams

- Manage program financials—budget planning, forecasting, and tracking—to ensure alignment with approved funding and business outcomes

Program Integration & Strategic Execution
- Develop and actively manage integrated program & project plans, including dependencies, sequencing, and critical path

- Continuously assess program & project health, identify risks and trade-offs, and adjust direction to maintain momentum

- Synthesize inputs across teams to provide a clear, program-level view of progress, risks, and decisions required

- Plan and structure programs to maximize business value through sound technical implementation, balancing technical realities with business priorities

Team Leadership & Oversight
- Set direction, expectations, and consistency in how work is planned, tracked, and delivered

- Elevate team performance by reinforcing strong program management discipline and accountability

- Oversee and direct other project managers as needed, particularly on large multifaceted programs

Executive Alignment & Decision Support
- Partner with executives and senior leaders to align priorities, timelines, and expected outcomes

- Serve as the trusted bridge technical delivery teams and Executive and Senior Business leaders—translating technical complexity into clear business implications and ensuring business priorities shape technical execution

- Provide clear, actionable insights to support decision-making, including risks, trade-offs, and recommendations

- Anticipate issues and surface solutions before they impact delivery

- Craft and deliver executive-level reporting—dashboards, status updates, and presentations—that clearly communicates program health, risks, and key decisions

Governance & Operating Rhythm
- Define and lead the program governance model, including leadership forums, working teams, and decision-making structures

- Ensure meetings drive decisions, accountability, and forward momentum—not just status updates

- Establish a consistent operating cadence that drives alignment, accountability, and execution across all workstreams

Stakeholder Influence & Organizational Navigation
- Build trust and credibility with Executives, enterprise, and business leaders through consistent delivery and sound judgment

- Navigate organizational complexity to align stakeholders, resolve conflicts, and move initiatives forward

- Influence outcomes across teams without direct authority

Risk, Issue & Dependency Management
- Ensure risks, issues, and dependencies are identified early and managed proactively

- Drive timely resolution and escalation with clear ownership and recommendations

- Maintain visibility into program-level impacts across all workstreams

Vendor & Partner Management
- Manage external vendors and partners, ensuring alignment to program objectives, timelines, and deliverables

- Oversee vendor performance, deliverables, and contractual obligations; address issues and ensure value realization

Change Management & Adoption
- Partner with business and functional leaders to develop and execute change management and communication plans

- Champion change, driving adoption and reinforcing a culture of adaptability and continuous improvement

Quality & Execution Standards
- Ensure leadership materials and communications are clear, concise, and decision-ready

- Set and uphold high standards for program outputs, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and alignment

Additional Job Description:
- Expert-level program and project management, with a proven track record delivering results through complex, cross-functional initiatives
- Proven leadership capability; able to influence outcomes and drive results across diverse teams
- Strong business and financial acumen, with the ability to understand enterprise priorities, connect program execution to strategic and financial outcomes, and engage credibly with Executive and Senior Business leaders
- Ability to fluently navigate both highly technical details and critical business needs, serving as the key leader who bridges technology teams and business leadership to ensure programs are planned and delivered to maximize business value
- Exceptional critical thinking; breaks down complex problems, identifies root causes, and develops creative, practical solutions
- Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in ambiguity, applying strong judgment to prioritize, decide, and lead programs through complexity, change, and uncertainty
- Outstanding influencing skills; with a proven ability to build trust, credibility, and drive alignment at all levels, including senior and executive leadership
- Strong results orientation, with the drive and resilience to deliver outcomes under challenging conditions
- Highly adaptable; prioritizes and executes effectively in fast-paced, evolving environments
- Exceptional communication, interpersonal skills, and emotional intelligence; expresses views clearly and concisely and engages, aligns, and influences stakeholders at all levels
- High level of accountability and ownership, paired with the humility to collaborate, listen, and adjust when needed
- Adaptable, resilient, and authentic; comfortable with ambiguity and complexity, with a genuine willingness to learn from feedback.
- Agility at building relationships and credibility across all levels of projects and organizations.
- Excellent negotiator; leads and achieves results under difficult conditions and stays composed under pressure.
- Exceptional ability to synthesize complex information, connect interdependencies across workstreams, and translate them into clear, actionable plans
- Deep knowledge of program and project management methodologies, tools, and best practices
- Strong knowledge of change management principles, methodologies, and best practices
- Experience managing in a player-coach environment

jobs.description:
Job Summary:
Our General Manager is responsible for the management of the ongoing day to day operations of the store, while adhering to Company policies and procedures; direct supervision of staff; maximizing store profits and ensuring a high level of customer service and store appearance.
At Global Partners, business starts with people. Since 1933, we’ve believed in taking care of our customers, our guests, our communities, and each other—and that belief continues to guide us.

The Global Spirit is how we work to fuel that long term commitment to success. As a Fortune 500 company with 90+ years of experience, we’re proud to fuel communities—responsibly and sustainably. Job Description:
- Maximize store profitability through managing all controllable expenses, optimizing all revenue streams, and leading and developing a high performing team.
- Responsible for guest and associate satisfaction, exceeding brand standards and managing the stores profitability.
- Select, develop and effectively lead a highly engaged team.
- Cultivate a positive shopping experience for all guests. Respond to guest complaints or inquiries. Solicit guest feedback, input, and information from various sources. Review information and create a plan to consistently meet the expectations of all guests.
- Responsible for staffing the store appropriately to cover the guest and business demands of a 24/7 business. Proactively identify hiring needs across the store.
- Allocate resources, delegate work, and effectively manage time through efficient scheduling and usage of labor hours.
- Conduct all aspects of management training. Overseeing and monitor the training of all associates to ensure proficiency of skills and job safety is taught.

- Value store associates through celebration and recognition.
- Support the development of associates and store management team through appropriate talent management processes (e.g., performance management, development plans, career conversations, development opportunities).
- Provide overall direction and support for team and monitor and assess individual work in accordance with high standards of excellence. Provide feedback, coaching, support opportunities for development, complete performance appraisals, take corrective action when appropriate, and participate in hiring decisions.
- Ensure conditions across the store meet or exceed standards for safety, service, and overall operational efficiency by analyzing opportunities and ensuring execution of established policies, procedures, practices and programs.
- Adhere to work designs and implement improvement actions across the store. Manage all safety programs and ensure proper execution and compliance.
- Report and document all guest and associate incidences in the appropriate time frame. Ensure compliance to all federal and local laws and to all company policies and procedures.
- Responsible for leading change initiatives, championing programs and educating associates on the reason and need for change. Ensure programs are executed according to design, integrated and sustained.
- Accountable to meet or exceed key performance metric targets/projections; deliver budgeted merchandise gross profit by executing the merchandise plan.
- Maintain awareness of store-level and organizational financial performance trends to help achieve store profitability.

- Competition surveys.

- Build relationships with community partners to connect the store with its community.

- Experience with labor allocation, sales building, scheduling, and managing expenses.

jobs.description:

The Territory Sales Manager will be a critical part of the Wholesale, reporting to the Region Manager of Wholesale. The Territory Sales Manager builds and maintains business relationships with Dealer customers. Job Description:
- Develop and nurture strong customer contacts and positive, proactive and profitable business relationships
- Solicit new business for supply contracts with brand or unbranded service station dealers and negotiate long term supply agreements.
- Monitor and coach dealers on pricing and awareness of competition pricing.
- Monitor dealer competitive map and add new competition as needed. Validate all internal reports are accurate pricing and competition
- Validate that all internal reports have accurate pricing and competitive information.

- Complete all administration functions between customers and company.

- Strong desire to solicit new business relationships with Dealer customers
- Coach your customers to effectively price their product for retail

- A positive, entrepreneurial mindset, a consistent desire to grow and be a part of a team that is focused on continuous improvement and a drive for results

- Ability to make decisions, firm, outgoing, analytical, ability to anticipate and solve problems, excellent communication skills, positive leadership ability

jobs.title: Associate Category  Manager
jobs.description:
Job Summary:
An Associate Category Manager owns the P&L and end-to-end category strategy for assigned categories across the convenience store business. Sets category priorities and translates customer, market, financial, vendor, and store insights into plans that deliver sales, gross margin, and other agreed business targets.
At Global Partners, business starts with people. Since 1933, we’ve believed in taking care of our customers, our guests, our communities, and each other—and that belief continues to guide us.

The Global Spirit is how we work to fuel that long term commitment to success. As a Fortune 500 company with 90+ years of experience, we’re proud to fuel communities—responsibly and sustainably. We show up every day with grit, passion, and purpose—anticipating needs, building lasting relationships, and creating shared value.

Job Description:
- Own the category P&L and business results for assigned portfolio. Track sales, gross margin dollars and rate, units, transactions, market share where available, budget, and prior-year performance; identify drivers and take action to close gaps or build on results.
- Develop and refresh annual and longer-term category strategies using customer needs, competitive and market information, financial performance, and store feedback. Set clear priorities and measurable objectives for assortment, pricing, promotions, space, vendor plans, and execution.
- Translate category strategy into quarterly and in-season plans. Make timely decisions, establish action plans and checkpoints, and adjust plans as performance, costs, competition, or customer demand changes.
- Monitor competitive activity, market data where available, customer trends, and emerging products; summarize relevant findings for category recommendations.
- Own assortment and item productivity across the lifecycle. Evaluate new items, costs, retails, distribution, and space; optimize the assortment and lead item launches, changes, and discontinuations.
- Lead category pricing and promotional strategy, including offer selection, timing, merchandising, vendor funding, and post-event evaluation. Use results to improve sales, gross profit, traffic, and promotional effectiveness.
- Lead vendor relationships and business reviews. Set expectations, review performance and commercial plans, pursue opportunities, resolve issues, and document decisions, commitments, and follow-up.
- Drive execution across stores by setting clear direction and partnering with Store Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, Marketing, Pricing, and vendors on availability, signage, planograms, pricing accuracy, and communication.
- Negotiate with vendors for lower total delivered cost, volume incentives, rebates, advertising, funding, and other applicable allowances.
- Works closely with field operations regarding execution, training and marketing.

Additional Job Description:
- Proficiency in one or more of the following tools: Excel, PowerBI and/or Tableau.
- You manage and take ownership of projects with supervision.
- You consistently meet deadlines and are results-oriented.
- You show communicative effectiveness in all interactions with all levels within the organization, external partners and collaborators.
- You possess the ability to create and deliver public presentations to peers and executives.
- You can collaborate and influence with and without authority.
- You have a basic understanding of P&L statements.
- You always demonstrate a professional demeanor.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Asset Management, Retail Real Estate
jobs.description:
Job Summary:
This role will lead the asset management strategy and execution for the Company’s 900+ location retail real estate portfolio (predominantly fuel stations with convenience stores and travel centers), with responsibility for maximizing long-term asset value, optimizing portfolio performance, managing QSR tenants, and executing strategic real estate initiatives, including acquisitions. The Senior Director of Asset Management will report to Senior Vice President of Real Estate and partner closely with Development and Construction, Property Management, Finance, Capital Planning, Retail Operations, Fuels Marketing, Environmental, and other internal stakeholders to develop and execute portfolio strategies aligned with enterprise objectives.
At Global Partners, business starts with people. Since 1933, we’ve believed in taking care of our customers, our guests, our communities, and each other—and that belief continues to guide us.

The Global Spirit is how we work to fuel that long term commitment to success. As a Fortune 500 company with 90+ years of experience, we’re proud to fuel communities—responsibly and sustainably. We show up every day with grit, passion, and purpose—anticipating needs, building lasting relationships, and creating shared value.

Job Description:
- Portfolio Strategy & Asset Optimization : Execute asset-level and portfolio-wide strategies designed to maximize economic value, improve portfolio quality and support the Company’s long-term retail real estate objectives. Maintain a comprehensive understanding of portfolio performance, market conditions, lease structures, property values and strategic opportunities; identify assets for acquisition, lease, disposition, or capital investment.
- Asset Management Leadership:  Lead and develop the Retail Real Estate Asset Management function, including oversight of the Director of Asset Management and collaboration with the broader real estate organization.
- Lease & Sublease Strategy:  Oversee lease and sublease negotiations, renewals, restructurings and amendments. Maintain strong landlord and tenant relationships. Manage non-gas tenant leases.
- Travel Center and QSR Tenant Strategy:  Play a critical leadership role in curating the tenant mix at travel plazas and lead negotiations of leases, subleases, concessions and other occupancy arrangements with travel center retailers including QSRs, restaurants, banks, service providers and other complimentary uses. Ideally this role brings a QSR relationship network to leverage.
- CAM & Reimbursement Oversight:  Lead the oversight and administration of common area maintenance (CAM), real estate taxes, insurance, utilities and other reimbursable occupancy expenses across the retail portfolio where the company acts either as tenant or landlord. Establish and maintain consistent processes, controls and reporting for CAM budgeting, billing, reconciliation and recoveries across the portfolio.
- Acquisitions & Strategic Investments:  Evaluate and oversee ROFRs, Purchase Options, Add Land opportunities and strategic acquisitions and leases for NTI (new-to-industry) or R&R (raze-and-rebuild) gas/fuel station, convenience store and travel plaza developments. Oversee due diligence processes for site acquisitions.
- Disposition Strategy:  Identify and evaluate potential property dispositions and develop strategies alongside the Senior Director of Real Estate Ventures to maximize proceeds and overall economic value while considering environmental liability and operational implications.
- Transaction Negotiation:  Lead or provide senior oversight of negotiations with property owners, landlords, tenants, brokers and other counterparties to achieve favorable economic and contractual outcomes.
- Financial Analysis & Underwriting:  Conduct and/or direct complex financial analyses and underwriting to inform transaction decisions. Strong financial analysis and excellent facility with mental math is crucial to this role.
- Cross-Functional Leadership : Coordinate with Legal, Finance, Retail Operations, Fuels Marketing, Development and Construction, Property Management and other stakeholders to ensure real estate decisions incorporate operational, financial and strategic considerations.
- Process & Performance Management:  Establish consistent asset management processes, SOPs, reporting standards, portfolio reviews and performance metrics to improve visibility, accountability and execution across the function.
- Executive Decision Support:  Develop clear recommendations and presentations for senior leadership regarding portfolio decisions, transactions, investments, risks and opportunities.

jobs.title: Manager, Business Intelligence
jobs.description:
Job Summary:
Join Global Partners LP as our Business Intelligence (BI) Analytics Manager for the Terminals business unit. Collaborating closely with leadership, terminal operations, and divisional teams, you will champion data-driven decision-making across the organization by designing and deploying timely analytics, defining key performance indicators, and implementing robust business intelligence solutions. Through your expertise in tools like SQL, Tableau, and modern data platforms—including Snowflake, dbt, and Fivetran—you will help ensure that terminal operations are optimized for profitability, efficiency, and growth.

The BI Manager, Terminals at Global Partners is responsible for driving operational insights, improving profitability, and empowering terminal teams with actionable intelligence. You’ll develop dashboards, optimize processes, and provide recommendations on terminal capacity, pricing strategies, scheduling, and asset utilization. Your analysis will directly support decisions related to terminal operations, acquisition strategies, and long-term planning, enabling us to maximize value and operational performance.

The ideal candidate will have strong analytical skills, proficiency in modern BI tools and analytics stacks, and a deep understanding of operational data workflows. They will play a crucial role in driving business growth and improving operational efficiency through data-driven recommendations.
At Global Partners, business starts with people. Since 1933, we’ve believed in taking care of our customers, our guests, our communities, and each other—and that belief continues to guide us.

The Global Spirit is how we work to fuel that long term commitment to success. As a Fortune 500 company with 90+ years of experience, we’re proud to fuel communities—responsibly and sustainably. We show up every day with grit, passion, and purpose—anticipating needs, building lasting relationships, and creating shared value.

Job Description:
- Lead and mentor (player coach) a team of BI analysts, fostering analytical rigor, technical skill development , with a culture of curiosity and data-driven insights.

- Partner with Retail leadership to define key performance indicators (KPIs) and develop robust analytical frameworks to measure business performance, identify trends, and track progress against strategic goals.

- Translate ambiguous business questions into specific, testable hypotheses and analytical plans; proactively identify areas where data analysis can deliver significant value.

- Lead the end-to-end development, delivery, and optimization of BI solutions, including dashboards and reports, utilizing SQL and BI platforms (Tableau, Power BI, etc.).

- Communicate complex analytical findings and strategic recommendations clearly and concisely to diverse audiences, including senior leadership, through compelling data storytelling and visualizations.

- Conduct deep-dive analyses using SQL, BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, etc.), and Python/R to uncover root causes, identify actionable opportunities for growth or optimization, and quantify business impact.

- Own the design, development, and continuous improvement of core Retail dashboards and reporting suites, ensuring data accuracy, clarity, and relevance for various Retail business verticals .

- Champion data literacy, drive adoption of self-service BI tools, and promote best practices in data governance within the Retail unit.

- Collaborate with central data teams to influence the design and evolution of data models and infrastructure needed to support robust retail analytics and data capabilities.

- Explore and apply appropriate statistical techniques or basic forecasting models to address specific retail challenges, such as customer behavior analysis or demand planning (nice-to-have).

- Champion data quality, consistency, and governance best practices within the Retail analytics domain.

Additional Job Description:
- Bachelor's degree in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, or related quantitative field.

- 5-7+ years in Business Intelligence or Data Analytics, demonstrating progressive responsibility.

- 2-3+ years of experience leading projects or directly managing/mentoring analytical staff .

- Proven experience translating business needs into analytical solutions and actionable insights within a business context. Experience within the Retail, C-Store, eCommerce, or related industries .

- Expert-level SQL skills for complex data extraction, transformation, and analysis.

- Deep expertise with major BI platforms (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, etc.) including dashboard design, development, and performance optimization.

- Exceptional data storytelling and communication skills, able to present complex information clearly and persuasively to diverse audiences.

- Strong leadership, mentoring, and collaboration skills; proven ability to manage and develop analysts as a player-coach.

- Excellent business acumen and problem-solving skills, particularly within a retail context.

- E xposure to data preparation/modeling tools (e.g., dbt , sqlmesh ).

- Exposure to Python or R for data analysis and automation.

- Experience with statistical analysis, forecasting techniques, or basic predictive modeling.

- Familiarity with cloud data warehouses ( e.g. Snowflake, BigQuery ).

- P assion for data quality, continuous learning, and fostering a data-informed culture.
